_about: International postgraduate taught fee payment policies, from each university's own pages (checked 4 Oct 2026). dep = minimum deposit before CAS; nepal = deposit for applicants from Nepal where it differs; plan = how the rest is paid; sched = installment dates by intake. Fields left out were not stated on the pages that could be read.

Imperial College London.depNote: Engineering, Medicine and Natural Sciences master's (Computing is in Engineering)
Imperial College London.plan: Pay in full, or in 2 installments if you meet the criteria (not available if fully sponsored)

University of Warwick.plan: Standard installment plan available to most self-funded students

University of Edinburgh.dep: Set per programme (shown in the degree finder and your offer)
University of Edinburgh.depNote: Where required, usually due within 28 days of the offer
University of Edinburgh.plan: Pay in full within 30 days of your invoice, or set up an installment plan (dates depend on your invoice date)

University of Sheffield.depNote: Needed before your CAS unless a recognised sponsor covers at least half your fee

University of Manchester.plan: At least one third at registration, the rest in 2 installments by set dates

Durham University.plan: 3 installments by Direct Debit (set up by 15 November)

Queen Mary Univ. of London.depNote: All overseas students needing a Student visa; some programmes also ask for a conditional deposit to hold the place (not for January starts)

University of Birmingham.dep: Required before CAS (amount in your applicant portal)
University of Birmingham.plan: Pay in full or in installments by Direct Debit; an interest charge applies to plans over £9,840

University of Bristol.dep: Set per programme (in your offer letter)
University of Bristol.plan: Pay at least 50% by the fee due date — in full or in 2 installments

sched.September intake: Pay in full (or first 50%) by 12 Oct 2026
sched.January intake: Pay in full (or first 50%) by 25 Jan 2027

University of St Andrews.plan: Pay in one payment or by installment plan (2026–27 plans open from mid-June 2026)

University of Exeter.dep: Required for full-time taught master's (amount in your offer)
University of Exeter.depNote: Deadline 1 Apr 2027 for offers made by 31 Jan 2027; 1 Jul 2027 for offers 1 Feb–31 May

University of Glasgow.depNote: CAS issued once paid; 25% admin fee if refunded

University of Bath.depNote: Non-refundable; full-time master's in Engineering & Design, Humanities & Social Sciences and Science
University of Bath.plan: Pay in 1 or 2 installments at registration

University of Southampton.plan: Fees due in full by 21 Sep 2026, or choose 3 installments if self-funding

Heriot-Watt University.plan: 4 equal monthly installments, October to January

Aston University.plan: 50% in term 1 (by 31 Oct), 25% in term 2, 25% in term 3 — card installments

Wrexham University.plan: Pay in full, or in 3 installments if the fee is over £1,000

University of Chester.depNote: Can be split: £1,500 initial deposit, then £3,500 by your deposit deadline
University of Chester.plan: Pay in full or in 2 installments

University of Liverpool.plan: Overseas taught students: 60% then 40% (deposit counts towards the first payment)

sched.September intake: 60% at start of term (28 Sep) · 40% later

University of Lincoln.depNote: Due after accepting an unconditional offer, before CAS
University of Lincoln.plan: Balance in one payment by the end of semester 1

Birmingham City University.plan: 50% at enrolment, the rest over 3 set installments

University of Wolverhampton.depNote: £500 off for paying 4 weeks before the deadline

Middlesex University.dep: £1,000 up to 50% of the first-year fee (stated in your offer)
Middlesex University.plan: Deposit, then 2 installments: 50% in September, the rest in January

sched.September intake: 50% end of September · balance in January

Sheffield Hallam University.plan: 50% before enrolment (less your deposit), balance later

University of Bradford.dep: Required before CAS (£200 admin fee if refunded)
University of Bradford.plan: Remaining balance in 2 equal installments; dates depend on intake (16 Jan & 1 Apr · 1 May & 1 Aug · 1 Jul & 1 Oct)

University of Brighton.plan: Remaining fees in full at the start, or in 2 installments

sched.September intake: Registration · early Jan (or registration · 4 Dec · 4 Feb · 4 Apr)
sched.January intake: Registration · early Apr (or registration · 4 Apr · 4 Jun · 4 Aug)

University of East London.plan: After the deposit, pay the balance within 10 weeks of starting (5 monthly installments over the first term)

Swansea University.depNote: £8,000 for some Indian states; 50% for Bangladesh, Ghana, Pakistan and Cameroon

University of Kent.depNote: Pre-CAS deposit for self-funded applicants needing a visa

Northumbria University.plan: Balance in full at enrolment, or 2 equal, 3 equal, or 6 monthly installments (first due immediately)

Brunel University of London.plan: Pay 50% of the year's fee before enrolment (including the deposit), the rest later

University of Plymouth.plan: Pay in full at enrolment, or in 3 installments

University of Surrey.plan: 2 installments: 50% 10 days after your invoice (start of semester 1), then the rest

sched.September intake: First day of term 1 (Oct) · first day of term 2 (Jan)

University of Stirling.plan: Balance in 4 installments every 2 months, 3 equal installments at the start of each semester, or monthly

University of Salford.plan: 7 consecutive monthly installments (starting a month after your course starts), or pay in full for a 3% discount

University of Westminster.depNote: Non-refundable; overseas students must reach 50% of the fee before enrolment
University of Westminster.plan: 50% by enrolment (deposit + top-up), the rest by installments

Goldsmiths, Univ. of London.plan: 3 termly installments (by card for January/April starts)

Univ. of the West of Scotland.plan: Balance in one installment, or 7 equal monthly installments (full-time)

Liverpool John Moores Univ..plan: After the deposit, pay in full or in 3 equal installments

Oxford Brookes University.dep: £1,000 or £3,000 by country, then a £5,000 top-up before CAS
Oxford Brookes University.plan: 2 equal installments, one at the start of each semester

Robert Gordon University.plan: Two 3-installment plans (e.g. 33% or 25% due by 1 November, then further installments)

Anglia Ruskin University.plan: Pay in full or in 2 installments

University for the Creative Arts.depNote: £5,500 for some countries; 50% for India (outside Punjab and Haryana)

Solent University.plan: Installment plans offered during online registration

UWE Bristol.plan: Pay £8,500 before or at enrolment (minus any deposit), the rest later

University of Suffolk.depNote: Also £10,000 for Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Sri Lanka and Punjab

Bath Spa University.plan: Full payment due before registration or by 18 September

Cranfield University.plan: Pay in full or in 2 equal installments (depends on course)

Buckinghamshire New University.plan: Pay in full or in 3 installments
